terms.comment: A modern coinage, “a building of many storeys”; not in Lewis & Short.

evidence: Hor. C. 1.4.13–14: pauperum tabernās rēgumque turrēs (Lewis & Short)
M-O s.v. floor: high-rise, tall building, tower block, skyscraper
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: “any high building, a castle, palace, citadel”; Morgan–Owens gives it for a high-rise and a skyscraper. With altissima where the height must be said.

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 380.
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. floor: high-rise, tall building, tower block, skyscraper.
